briefdescription.para: Chaos and edge-case tests for the HTTP server network stack.

detaileddescription.para:
Validates robustness under adversarial conditions:
Oversized request bodies (payload too large)
Oversized request headers (request header fields too large)
Missing/empty content body
Malformed JSON payloads
Repeated concurrent requests
Request ID generation / propagation
Server config boundary conditions
These tests operate at the configuration and logic level (no live TCP server) and through the MonitoringApiHandler to keep test execution fast and dependency-free.
